title: Anonymous local and Tokyo Magpie quota evidence
adoption_status: Research-only PR. Conditional measured evidence, not a change to the adopted price table.
adoption_reason: CONVENTIONS.md section 3 requires maintainer resolution of conflicting measurements. Different account variants, workloads and reset cycles must not be silently averaged or replace existing anchors.

conventions.role: 定义当前采用、计算、绘图和公开发布共用的项目口径
conventions.formula: 订阅价 ÷ 用户实际能用到的月 token = 真实混合单价

exchangeRate.units: CNY per USD; legacy field usdPerCny stores this direction
exchangeRate.labelZh: 中国外汇交易中心中间价，新华社转载
exchangeRate.note: 2026-09-05为周六，采用最近交易日9月4日中间价；非银行卡实际结算价。100美元=677.87人民币。

conventions.unmeteredPolicy: 订阅内明确不占额度、无并发上限的模型：真实单价记 0、显示为 ≈$0/MTok（分母无界，趋于 0 而非精确 0），X 轴以专用‘不计额度’刻度位表示、不进对数换算；参与前沿。促销口径必须标截止日并在到期后复核。

devin_swe2.labelZh: SWE-2 促销：Pro/Max/Teams 不计额度
devin_swe2.endDateBasis: 2026-09-12 给定；官推仅写 for the next month

conventions.tokenPolicy: 所有 token 一视同仁；美元额度和三段价统一按项目标准负载折算

standardTokenMix.labelZh: 项目统一标准负载：缓存读取97% / 普通输入2.5% / 输出0.5%
standardTokenMix.labelEn: Project standard workload: 97% cache reads / 2.5% fresh input / 0.5% output
standardTokenMix.note: 固定比较口径，不代表任何平台或用户的实际负载；三项合计100%。当前不单列cache write；厂商另收缓存写入费时，换算可能偏高估token。2026-09-23 由 97.5%/2.15%/0.35% 修订为本值：standard-token-mix-round2-2026-09-23.json 14样本审计（输出中位0.51%、输入中位2.79%、剔除网关池化96.89/2.57/0.54），裁定。

lowCacheTokenMix.labelZh: 低缓存负载：缓存读取85% / 普通输入14.5% / 输出0.5%
lowCacheTokenMix.labelEn: Low-cache workload: 85% cache reads / 14.5% fresh input / 0.5% output
lowCacheTokenMix.note: 2026-09-22 裁定的第二档统一负载，用于实测打不到标准 97% cache 的渠道（当前：Step 全系、Google——Gemini 实测 82.6% 属同族，2026-09-30 裁定其实测样本按标价折 worth 后用本档换算）。锚点：step-5-preview 本机实测 mix 79.0%/20.7%/0.34%（210.17M tokens，stepfun-step5-panel-round5-2026-09-21.json）与 Google AI Pro 实测 82.6%，统一取 85% 档；step5 采用值的 decision_note 内保留 79% 实测口径对照数。非cache部分输出占比 0.5% 跟随标准负载、余量归输入。2026-09-23 随标准档由 85%/14.65%/0.35% 修订（standard-token-mix-round2-2026-09-23.json）。

anthropicTokenMix.labelZh: Anthropic 统一负载：缓存读97% / 缓存写2.5% / 输出0.5%
anthropicTokenMix.labelEn: Anthropic workload: 97% cache reads / 2.5% cache writes / 0.5% output
anthropicTokenMix.note: Anthropic 单独收缓存写入费，未命中缓存的输入几乎全部走缓存写（Devin 面板 input 0.001%/write 7.67%；MiaAI Claude Code 样本 input 0.14%/write 2.05%），故标准档的普通输入份额对 Anthropic 按 5 分钟缓存写入价计；份额与 standardTokenMix 联动（cacheWrite = standard.input）。2026-09-24 裁定。

collection.deduplication: Same upstream response ID and complete token vector; retain upstream provider record over the local forwarding alias. Shared accounts and histories are one pool, not independent hosts.

direct_audit.limitation: All 48 page totals were stable. No snapshot-isolation guarantee; captured candidates can downgrade evidence, but absence of other direct usage is not proven. Grades capped at medium.

tokyo_direct_audit.method: Read-only magpie usage --csv --days 11 inside the existing container
tokyo_direct_audit.limitation: No direct-session rows found by the installed CLI; this does not prove no activity outside its discovered sources.

collection.account_identity: Anonymous stable references only. No emails, host addresses, request/session IDs, credentials, prompts or absolute private paths exported.

qualification_policy.interpretation: Local evidence rubric; thresholds are not vendor rules or confidence probabilities

methodology.unmetered_models: Excluded under the pinned repository promotion rules.
methodology.rejected_mixed_pools: No model contribution proxy or NNLS value admitted as exclusive capacity.
methodology.month: Four weeks; Kimi uses the project convention of five weekly pools. These are saturated comparison scenarios.
methodology.rounding: Endpoint +/-1pp sensitivity; not a statistical confidence interval.
methodology.miniMax_exception: M3.1 Flash Preview has no adopted independent reference rates. Raw only under the existing 2026-10-01 exception; the newer minimax-m3.1-flash identifier is not assumed identical.
methodology.grade: Transparent evidence rubric, not a probability. Statistical grade is separate from tier/fee confirmation and population representativeness.
methodology.limits: Conditional observational estimates. Hidden client activity, sampling latency, price/weight changes and account variants can alter capacity. Arithmetic can be reproduced from anonymous aggregates; private raw attribution cannot be independently authenticated from this public edition.

official_facts.different_scopes: The refreshed GOAT page headline says 80 and its per-model section says up to 80; its Usage limits section and the separate usage-limits table still say 70 monthly / 14 five-hour / 35 weekly. Preserve both observations. Do not replace the shared pool with 80 or treat per-model allowances as additive.
official_facts.unit: Vendor usage credits; monthly allowance and window slices are not additive and not universal API-list-dollar balances.

excluded_legacy_constants.reason: Old local collector constants are not current vendor evidence. Neither they nor percentage-only cache records establish an actual current window cap.
